events.title: Top Spotify Artist 2026

This market will resolve according to the name of the artist listed by Spotify as the top artist in the US of 2026.

If multiple artists tie for top artist in the US for 2026, this market will resolve according to the artist whose listed name comes first in alphabetical order.

If Spotify does not release who their top artist in the US for 2026 is by January 31, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".
